capabilities: Shows current note and vault name in Discord Rich Presence
Displays a read or write indicator icon
Customizes activity type, icon, and elapsed time counter
Hides file and vault names via privacy mode
Connects and disconnects from Discord via status bar or commands
intentEvidence: Vault Presence is a fork of obsidian-discordrpc by Luke Leppan
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display which note or vault you are working in within Discord.

relations.evidence: Vault Presence is a fork of obsidian-discordrpc by Luke Leppan, who created the original plugin and its base.

summary: Discord Rich Presence integration that shows your current Obsidian note, vault name, and elapsed work time in Discord.
